user_request_summary: 继续推进到实测前完整审查节点，保持设计、实际实现、贡献与未验证边界一致。
goal: 原生目录和完整读取接入实际 SDK、共同预算、只读恢复、报告及公平对照，保全原件与未知状态。
changes: Explicit approved static policy plus explicit applicability selects session/report/completion 13/10/7 and identical 20-tool on/off interfaces; older generations retain original tools/shapes.

Native middleware injects only the catalog factor; full read_skill results, metadata, bodies and permissions are identical across modes, ordinary retrieval can derive the same selected content identity.
Actual fixed and MockTransport solver requests validate the final native catalog before dispatch; provider transport concatenates only exact system text blocks without dropping characters.

Full reads bind actual accounted solver requests/responses and durable action receipts; compact facts separately count successful reads and later complete visible receipts, never grant current evidence or application authority.

Resume checks the original approval, run originals, policy, latest native cache and relevant pending writes before writable ledgers; strict SDK serializer is used for both admission and static graph execution.

Shared or unsafe checkpoint entries, unmerged journals, resource/profile/policy drift and unknown results reject/reconcile without reexecuting the read; external source library is unnecessary on resume.
Publication preflights the two ASCII static report fragments and link budgets; solver original closure retains its existing 8 MiB single/64 MiB total limits and counts initial plus closing rereads.

Manifest5 freezes shared knowledge and static resource identity, exports complete originals/receipts/actual inputs and rejects old-generation residuals; missing reports/ledgers leave use/cost unknown.
Matrix row, variant and paired result accumulation is bounded by actual canonical UTF-8 writer bytes including provenance, digest and newline, with an independent final limit check.
Updated the existing guide, architecture, contracts, plan, metrics, prototype instructions and STATUS; submission templates and archive dependencies are unchanged.

validation.skip_reason: Three actual symbolic-link cases lack Windows account privilege; actual hard-link rejection is separately verified.
validation.counting_rule: Latest passing result per selected file only; repeated intermediate successes are not counted twice. Final text typing/path admission edits prompted focused provider/SDK/cache rechecks.

retained_failed_attempts.cause: Native config parameter typed Any prevented SDK injection; typed RunnableConfig.
Provider finite profile rejected native SystemMessage text blocks; added exact text-only concatenation.
UTF-8 boundary fixture was actually ASCII; explicit synthetic Unicode probe added.
Late input probe changed returned messages but not actual frozen view; synchronized probe to test static gate rather than request mismatch.
Checked text-block dictionary needed explicit type narrowing; runtime semantics unchanged.

review_findings_resolved: Default permissive checkpoint serializer could construct unregistered msgpack types before cache comparison; native strict mode is now explicit at both boundaries.
Closing solver-input reads were undercounted and inherited the unrelated knowledge closure; dedicated solver reader now honors its original budgets.
read_skill exposed an extra enabled flag to the model; removed it so full read results are identical and catalog is the isolated factor.
exists() alone can miss an unsafe dangling checkpoint entry; lstat and owned-file validation now precede admission.
limitations: Managed fixed/mock scripts and CLI still cannot configure knowledge, applicability or static policies; program API integration is not CLI acceptance.
No feedback extraction, automatic Skill revision/activation, complete learned-source closure or learning gain is implemented.
Static host_curated guidance and model applicability judgments do not confer current causal truth, business correctness or application verification.
Fragment and matrix output limits are not full-domain run capacity, tree-snapshot/total-I/O/memory or single-row peak guarantees.
Locked SQLite cache inspection has a bounded serialized checkpoint/pending-cache admission path; general platform/long-path/full-run capacity still needs integration acceptance.
Actual symbolic-link privilege cases and Windows general long-path publication remain unresolved; short fixtures are not proof.
Synthetic scripted repair, reuse and export tests prove neither autonomous model reasoning nor competition/paper effect or novelty.
next_work: W07 managed approved knowledge/applicability/static configuration and repair/resume/matrix/package acceptance, then feedback/evolution and complete offline review gates.

environment.mode: existing project-managed Python and locked dependencies
environment.observation: After final selected software and Ruff/Pyright checks; subsequent docs checks add retained artifacts only.
